description:
ElvenSector adds elves to Starsector. 👍

Quick balance and bugfix update/patch to ElvenSector, balance suggestions are always welcome, please dm me with said balance suggestions or bug reports.

Changelog:
-Assorted balancing changes and buffs.
-Fixed a problem (oopsie on my behalf) of the Boiler Gun having a mistagged slot size.
0.1.2 is a small update/patch, more content soon.

Probably save-compatible

Download: https://mega.nz/file/8rdXnT7R#zs_hxhKXU9FfORl8N9jcwO-pX_8HsHchd-lezJQYI_s
